acceptance_criteria: All five theory targets complete at the production scale and every probability observable is bounded.
All six central 0.015 imbalance and edge-density crossings resolve with nonnegative intermediate widths.
The q=6→8, L=610→738, phase 6→12 and tube-node 8→15 profiles satisfy the target-specific absolute tolerances in the config.
Normalization/orthogonality invariants and the independent sparse-ARPACK probe both pass.
Any stable mismatch remains inconclusive unless a fresh protocol-v2 reviewer supplies explicit falsification and the complete paper-error discrepancy record.
